description: Agents can run Bash, edit files and drive Computer-Use inside a workspace's folders. Trust a folder before allowing that; untrusted workspaces run in Restricted Mode (read-only tools only).
enabledHint: When off, every workspace is treated as trusted and no Restricted Mode is applied.
promptOnSwitchHint: Ask to trust as soon as you switch to an untrusted workspace, instead of waiting for the first message.
title: Workspace Trust
